sourceCoverage: Printable characters in current src TS/TSX/JSON/CSS and index.html, excluding generated fonts.css; ASCII source/comments plus NBSP, bullet and ellipsis are included. New glyphs fail the standard-library coverage guard. Removed glyphs do not require regeneration.

verification.browserSubsetOnlyDefault: passed: default initial18,868B subset request only; full face unloaded; preload reused
verification.browserFullFallbackForUncommonCharacter: passed: separate localbrowser context 丁U+4E01 loads the original701,520B full font
verification.browserCanvasOutlineAndMetricParity: passed:20 text/size combinations; every RGBA pixel and measureText metric equal to original full font
verification.browserNoJavaScript: passed: subset loading, all static sections and native details
verification.browserBothHostingBases: passed: root74 and Pages74 independent checks

limits: Subsetting reduces startup font bytes, not original font glyph quality or physical display FPS.
Characters outside this subset use the original full face if that face contains them; absent original glyphs still use the existing fallback family.
CI standard-library verification checks source coverage and committed byte hashes; exact outline/metric comparison additionally requires authoring tools.
